summary: Reconstruct one Cartesian image from undersampled multi-coil k-space and sensitivity maps.
notes: Sensitivity-map estimation belongs to the planned org.kspacejet.calibration/sensitivity_map_estimate Operator. This consumer must receive its immutable sensitivity maps through a future explicit calibration binding, never by inferring or retaining hidden shared Provider state. Solver choice, convergence, cancellation, device placement, resource bounds, and terminal behavior remain unimplemented.
